UK Disability Benefits Review Rejects Stricter Rules Amid Rising Costs

A review into the United Kingdom's disability benefits system has decided against implementing tougher rules, despite acknowledging soaring costs. The review's findings indicate a rejection of stricter eligibility criteria, opting instead to maintain current regulations. The cost of these benefits to the government has been a significant point of discussion.
